This unconstrained entry includes signature authorization/new allowance installation, not merely consumption of already-established financial authority; no invented empty-bytes restriction is imposed.

It therefore combines new signature/allowance installation with staking, not a pure existing-authority finance operation. Empty signature is not a catalog ABI constraint.
